opportunities.name: Grenade Charge Mark
opportunities.objective: Log E stun mark and charged-shot timing.
opportunities.mechanic: E champion hits fully charge nearby turrets, while W rockets add 20% charge each. Mandate vulnerability can come from the center E stun; Rylai tests retention after charged shots and Cryptbloom can heal on the resulting takedown. AP supports E/W and documented upgraded turret shots.
opportunities.requiredState: Active turrets near the enemy and E center connects with allied follow-up.
opportunities.failure: Turrets are inactive/destroyed or grenade only slows.
opportunities.test: Log E stun mark and charged-shot timing; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Grenade peripheral slow alone is not the catalog Mandate immobilization trigger.

opportunities.name: Apex Eight Second Zone
opportunities.objective: Measure Apex shots and Riftmaker combat timer through stasis.
opportunities.mechanic: R Q turret lasts eight seconds, has AP shots/charged shots and a built-in slow. Riftmaker can ramp only while Heimer is in champion combat; Cosmic/P tower movement support staying near the zone, and Zhonya buys controller survival. This relies on AP scaling, not pet attack-item inheritance.
opportunities.requiredState: R Q is chosen and a champion stays inside its zone for several seconds.
opportunities.failure: Enemies wait out eight seconds or controller combat tracking does not recognize pet damage.
opportunities.test: Measure Apex shots and Riftmaker combat timer through stasis; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Pet attacks do not inherit Heimer's Nashor or personal lifesteal.

ruledOut.reason: Q/R describe turret attacks but grant no ownership of Heimer personal on-hit items.

unknowns: Ordinary Q turret shot coefficients are absent from resolved tooltip; P speed and E slow are unresolved tokens. Pet item-proc ownership must be observed.

builds.name: Grenade Charge Mark
builds.summary: Log E stun mark and charged-shot timing.
builds.goal: Log E stun mark and charged-shot timing.
builds.hypothesis: E champion hits fully charge nearby turrets, while W rockets add 20% charge each. Mandate vulnerability can come from the center E stun; Rylai tests retention after charged shots and Cryptbloom can heal on the resulting takedown. AP supports E/W and documented upgraded turret shots.
testPlan: Required state: Active turrets near the enemy and E center connects with allied follow-up.
Log E stun mark and charged-shot timing; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Turrets are inactive/destroyed or grenade only slows.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Grenade peripheral slow alone is not the catalog Mandate immobilization trigger.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Imperial Mandate, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Blackfire Torch, Cryptbloom, Rabadon's Deathcap, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of [5] rockets that deal [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage.

Max Damage: [90 / 135 / 180 / 225 / 270 + (1.03) × AP] magic damage.

Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion.

Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.

H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals [80 / 100 / 120 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per shot and [100 / 140 / 180 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal [135 / 180 / 225 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: [503 / 697.5 / 892 + (1.83) × AP] magic damage. 

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.

Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage in an area and Slows by @SlowPercent.0*100@% for [2] seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.

Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have [3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3] turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack.

If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds.

This Ability has [3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3] charges.
